# Tool Registry

Tracks researched tools. Check before first use, update after research.

| Tool | Version | Date | Key Learnings |
|------|---------|------|---------------|
| Appium `wdaConnectionTimeout` | appium-webdriveragent 16.13.6 | 2026-10-06 | The capability is the `WebDriverProxy` per-request timeout applied to every proxied WDA command, including `POST /session` during session creation — not just the initial connection. A cold app launch can exceed 90 s and fail with "Unable to start WebDriverAgent session ... timeout of 90000ms exceeded". Keep the xcuitest driver default of 240 s (inside the client's five-minute session budget). `wdaStartupRetries: 1` deliberately disables xcuitest's startup retry loop, so this timeout is the only startup margin. |
| git-filter-repo | 2.47.0 | 2026-10-06 | `pip install --user git-filter-repo`; on Windows invoke the exe under `%APPDATA%\Python\Python312\Scripts` directly since it is not on PATH. Run on a fresh `git clone --mirror`; `--invert-paths --paths-from-file` strips paths across all refs including tags. Old objects stay in the pack until `reflog expire --expire=now --all` + `gc --prune=now`, so measure `size-pack` only after GC. Stripping this repo's generated dumps took the pack from 395 MB to ~15 MB. |
| git lfs migrate | git-lfs 3.7.1 | 2026-10-06 | `git lfs migrate import --everything --include=<globs>` rewrites every ref, converts matched blobs to LFS pointers, and appends LFS rules to `.gitattributes` in the rewritten commits. GitHub bills LFS to the repo owner: storage counts every migrated historical version (1 GB free), and each clone checkout downloads that revision's objects (1 GB/mo free); `actions/checkout` defaults to `lfs: false` and fetches pointers only. Migrating this repo's dumps produced a 9 MB pack with a 1.9 GB LFS store. |
| Cold Appium reader snapshot | XCUITest 12.15.0 | 2026-10-05 | In [merge-queue run 37353901272](https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/actions/runs/37353901272/job/111912697150), the first PerekSource lookup took 70 seconds and returned an empty loading-page snapshot; the reader appeared during that request and was visible in the failure diagnostics. A 45-second polling loop could not perform a fresh lookup after the slow result. Give initial reader readiness a shared two-minute gate after session creation, capture startup failure diagnostics, and retain 45-second deadlines for all subsequent interactions. |
| VSTest mobile hang diagnostics | Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.10.1; xUnit 2.9.3 | 2026-10-05 | The hang watchdog covers xUnit session initialization and diagnostic capture as well as scenario assertions. In [run 37335059230](https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/actions/runs/37335059230/job/111848335062), iOS session creation took 268 seconds, startup assertions passed and a screenshot was saved, then the six-minute watchdog terminated the host during page-source capture while the app remained alive. The ten-minute per-test watchdog landed in #1962; retain the five-minute client startup timeout and 45-second interaction waits. Read each element's location and size once per layout check because each property access is a separate device query. [VSTest options](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/dotnet-test-vstest). |
| Codecov TLS diagnostics | action v7; CLI 11.3.1 | 2026-10-05 | Check download and ingestion endpoints independently. The served `*.codecov.io` certificate expired at 2026-10-04 23:59:59 UTC; ingestion and API calls failed certificate validation on Windows, and CI uploads failed after retries. The official PyPI distribution can install the CLI when the binary CDN is unavailable, but cannot repair the ingestion service's certificate. At 09:32 UTC, both endpoints passed TLS validation; retrying the failed reporting job uploaded coverage successfully with signature checks, TLS validation and existing failure gates intact. [Action](https://github.com/codecov/codecov-action/blob/v7/action.yml), [wrapper](https://github.com/codecov/codecov-action/blob/v7/dist/codecov.sh). |
| XCUITest tap readiness | driver 12.15.0 | 2026-10-05 | Read `hittable` with GetAttribute: XCTest's isHittable is excluded from page XML by default. An element-relative XCTest tap returned success while the menu stayed closed on a fresh runner. The pilot now sends one W3C touch down/up pair at the observed viewport center with a 100 ms pause, below the long-press threshold. Export native Pressed/Released/Clicked and animation logs to distinguish delivery from application state. Keep native actions in the platform adapter and require the same business assertions after the touch. [Attributes](https://appium.github.io/appium-xcuitest-driver/latest/reference/element-attributes/), [gestures](https://appium.github.io/appium-xcuitest-driver/latest/guides/gestures/). |
| macOS sample | built-in macOS 26 command | 2026-10-05 | `sample <pid> 2 1 -mayDie -file <path>` records all native thread stacks for two seconds at 1 ms intervals. `-mayDie` preserves symbols when an automated app exits or crashes during collection; no UI is opened. Collect only after failed tests: background symbolication timed out and competed with healthy iOS sessions on CI. Allow two minutes for sampling and 30 seconds for process lookup. Startup checkpoints and fresh `.ips` reports locate the failing native transition when XCTest cannot retrieve the view tree. [Apple command manual](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sample.1.html). |
| MAUI Shell content replacement | Controls 10.0.110 | 2026-10-05 | Keep startup and reading in one ShellContent to reuse its native navigation container. Clear ContentTemplate before assigning Content, otherwise ShellContent retains the templated page cache. The iOS renderer observes Content changes and replaces the page handler. Verify native startup, flyout and back navigation in both matrix jobs. [ShellContent source](https://github.com/dotnet/maui/blob/10.0.110/src/Controls/src/Core/Shell/ShellContent.cs), [iOS renderer](https://github.com/dotnet/maui/blob/10.0.110/src/Controls/src/Core/Compatibility/Handlers/Shell/iOS/ShellSectionRootRenderer.cs). |
| MAUI startup diagnostics | Controls 10.0.110 | 2026-10-05 | Put checkpoints before and after page initialization; managed exceptions crossing UIKit callbacks can appear as native Swift/Observation crashes. XAML property assignment can invoke CheckedChanged before InitializeComponent finishes assigning named fields. Attach handlers that touch other named controls after initialization. Apple asset targets also run dependencies before BeforeTargets hooks: add generated ImageAsset items before _BeforeCoreCompileImageAssets, rather than the outer _CompileImageAssets target. |
| GitHub Actions cancellation | workflow status conditions | 2026-10-05 | Aggregate jobs need `always() && !cancelled()` to evaluate test failures while releasing the PR concurrency slot when a newer head replaces the run. An unguarded always() job may keep a cancelled workflow alive. Keep failure diagnostic upload steps on always(). If ordinary cancellation cannot finish a superseded run, the workflow-runs force-cancel API bypasses always() conditions. [GitHub API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs#force-cancel-a-workflow-run). |
| WebDriverAgent | 16.13.6 (locked XCUITest dependency) | 2026-10-05 | Use `appium driver run xcuitest download-wda -- --kind=sim --platform=iOS` to fetch the official agent matching the installed driver's dependency and host architecture. `usePreinstalledWDA` plus `prebuiltWDAPath` launches it without compiling inside a session. On iOS, `fullReset=true` uninstalls the application before a session. The pilot uses `noReset=false`, `fullReset=false`, and `enforceAppInstall=true` to reset and reinstall the app on the booted simulator. [Guide](https://appium.github.io/appium-xcuitest-driver/latest/guides/run-prebuilt-wda/), [capabilities](https://appium.github.io/appium-xcuitest-driver/latest/reference/capabilities/). |
| NuGet dependency snapshots | component-detection action 0.2.0; dependency-review action 5 | 2026-10-06 | The SDK labels PR snapshots with the head SHA, while default checkout scans the synthetic merge. Match source and metadata; submit the actual merge base and head with a stable correlator; the API compares their common ancestor, not necessarily the current base tip. Version-only bases can also lack graphs. Preserve the exact required `submit-nuget` check in PR and queue contexts with failing aggregate gates; reusable/matrix check names are scoped. Historical bases retain the legacy `submit-nuget` slot alongside `nuget`; scan the real restored source into both slots, requiring nonempty graphs. The review action can pass after its retry timeout with snapshot warnings still present. Verify the comparison API again after review and fail on warnings, network/HTTP errors or invalid responses; retain vulnerability and license gates. [Submission inputs](https://github.com/advanced-security/component-detection-dependency-submission-action/blob/v0.2.0/action.yml), [review inputs](https://github.com/actions/dependency-review-action/blob/v5/action.yml), [comparison API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/dependency-graph/dependency-review). |
| AWS Rust SDK HTTPS features | aws-sdk-s3 1.152.0 | 2026-10-06 | The SDK's defaults enable both the current default HTTPS client and an obsolete `rustls` connector. Select `sigv4a`, `http-1x`, `default-https-client`, and `rt-tokio` explicitly to keep current behavior while removing the old TLS dependency tree. Five unit tests, a local HTTP integration test and strict Clippy pass. [SDK configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-rust/latest/dg/http.html). |
| Appium Android bundled dependencies | UiAutomator2 8.7.0 | 2026-10-06 | Published `inBundle` dependencies retain vulnerable copies after exact npm overrides, lockfile updates and clean installation. Top-level patched copies do not prove the bundle is fixed. A supported rebuilt distribution is required; track [#1995](https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1995) and keep alerts and Renovate enabled. |
| NuGet.Packaging | 7.9.0 | 2026-10-04 | .NET SDK 10.0.401's MSBuild requires NuGet.Frameworks 7.9.0. Keep NUKE's direct NuGet.Packaging dependency aligned so solution evaluation does not load the older assembly and emit a suppressed `InvalidProjectFileException`. [Release](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/nuget/release-notes/nuget-7.9). |
| npm install scripts | 11.19.1 | 2026-10-04 | Node 26's npm requires `allowScripts` for reviewed install hooks. `npm install-scripts ls --json` identifies pending hooks; `npm install-scripts approve <package>` records a version-specific approval in `package.json`. The mobile build needs esbuild's binary setup and Appium's extension setup. Re-run `npm ci` to verify the approved hooks execute without warnings. |
| Appium | 3.8.0; .NET client 9.0.0; UiAutomator2 8.7.0; XCUITest 12.15.0 | 2026-10-04 | Install the server and drivers together through `app/mobile-e2e/package-lock.json`; Appium discovers npm-managed drivers in that package. Use the default root server URL, explicit device UDIDs and fresh app sessions. Serialize scenarios within one device and parallelize platform runners through the CI matrix. Native locators and layout expectations live in platform adapters. [Client](https://github.com/appium/dotnet-client), [UiAutomator2](https://github.com/appium/appium-uiautomator2-driver). |
| Android emulator runner | 2.38.0 | 2026-10-05 | Linux CI uses KVM and an x86_64 API 36 image. Match the app RID to `android-x64` and embed assemblies in Debug APKs; Fast Deployment APKs cannot run on a fresh CI emulator. Select `-no-metrics` explicitly for unattended CI: emulator 37.2.12 warns that an unset telemetry choice will become an interactive prompt. This configures telemetry rather than disabling a test or hiding diagnostics. [Action](https://github.com/ReactiveCircus/android-emulator-runner). |
| Android emulator (local Windows) | 36.x; AEHD 2.2 | 2026-10-06 | Headless setup without Android Studio: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk` via `cmdline-tools` zip + `sdkmanager "platform-tools" "emulator" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" "system-images;android-36;google_apis;x86_64" "extras;google;Android_Emulator_Hypervisor_Driver"`. Current emulator builds refuse x86_64 images without hardware acceleration (no TCG fallback). When no Hyper-V hypervisor runs (`HypervisorPresent=False`, WSL1-only), WHPX cannot accelerate; install the AEHD package once elevated via `extras\google\Android_Emulator_Hypervisor_Driver\silent_install.bat` (`-accel-check` then reports `AEHD is installed and usable`, exit 0). `sdkmanager`/`avdmanager` need `JAVA_HOME` (Microsoft OpenJDK 21 zip) and a `.bat` suffix under Git Bash. Build+deploy to a running emulator: `dotnet build -t:Install -f net10.0-android -c Debug -p:TargetFrameworks=net10.0-android -p:RuntimeIdentifier=android-x64 -p:RuntimeIdentifiers=android-x64 -p:EmbedAssembliesIntoApk=true` from `app/BibleOnSite` — the csproj pre-step runs `devops/setup-dev-env.mts decompress-perushim-notes`, so `npm ci` in root `devops` must run first. Write `Resources/Raw/api-config.txt` (gitignored) to `https://api.xn--febl3a.com` for prod content. Create + boot headless: `avdmanager create avd -n bos_shots -k "system-images;android-36;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_7` then `emulator -avd bos_shots -no-snapshot -no-metrics -noaudio` (~100s cold boot, `adb wait-for-device`). Screenshots: `adb exec-out screencap -p > shot.png`. |
| Docker BuildKit | docker driver (Buildx) | 2026-10-04 | The default `docker` driver supports host networking and inline image cache. Export the `deps` target separately: standalone multi-stage output does not retain the `npm ci` layer. Import with `type=registry,ref=...`, not a local image loaded by `docker load`. Use `--no-cache-filter builder` for fresh RDS-backed SSG. Normalize only root manifest versions to retain dependency hits across releases. [Inline cache](https://docs.docker.com/build/cache/backends/inline/), [stage cache filter](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/buildx/build/#no-cache-filter). |
| Node.js | 26.10.0 | 2026-09-29 | Current release; use the same version in `.nvmrc`, npm engine ranges, Docker images, and CI lockfile checks. The official Windows zip provides a portable npm 11.19.1 for local validation. [Release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.10.0). |
| Rust | 1.98.1 | 2026-09-29 | Stable point release fixes a 1.98.0 vtable miscompilation; use it for API and bulletin Docker builds and Rust workspace checks. [Release](https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/09/03/Rust-1.98.1/). |
| TypeScript | 7.0.2 | 2026-09-29 | Admin and website type checks pass after regenerating stale Next route types; the admin bundler warning types now come from Rolldown. |
| Vitest | 5.0.2 | 2026-09-29 | Admin's 300 unit tests pass under Node 26 with matching `@vitest/coverage-v8` 5.0.2. |
| MongoDB Rust driver | 3.9.1 | 2026-09-29 | Use `default-features = false` with `bson-3`, `rustls-tls`, `dns-resolver`, and `compat-3-3-0` to align the data pipelines with BSON 3; the default compatibility feature still enables BSON 2. |
| SWC coverage plugin | 0.0.33 | 2026-09-29 | Requires Next 16.4 canary's newer bundled SWC; 16.3.6 fails to deserialize the plugin. All 986 website tests pass with coverage under Node 26 Alpine. |
| Nitro | 3.0.260903-beta | 2026-09-29 | The patched beta builds the admin with Vite 8 and avoids the advisory range affecting the older nightly alias. [Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5w89-w975-hf9q), [open redirect](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9phm-9p8f-hw5m). |
| sqlite3 | 3.51.1 | 2026-01-03 | Path: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\SQLite.SQLite_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\sqlite3.exe`. Installed via WinGet. Use for querying SQLite databases. |
| icu_calendar | 2.1.1 | 2025-07-01 | Unicode-3.0 license (permissive). Hebrew calendar: `Date::try_new_iso(y,m,d).to_calendar(Hebrew::new())`. Access: `extended_year()`, `month().ordinal` (1-13), `day_of_month().0`. Months start from Tishrei. Leap years have 13 months (Adar I at ordinal 6, Adar II at 7). |
| Biome | 2.5.14 | 2026-09-29 | Keep `$schema` aligned with the installed CLI. Use `linter.rules.preset: "recommended"`; top-level `linter.rules.recommended` is deprecated. |
| Playwright | 1.63.0 | 2026-10-02 | Wait for the actual lazy-loaded FlipBook after book-route reloads, not only its wrapper. Trace snapshots can slow velocity-sensitive mouse swipes; native CDP input preserves the move/release sequence without changing the tested gesture or disabling tracing. After a 30ms press, await the first native move, then queue the remaining moves and release together. This preserves Hammer's velocity sampling interval and prevents Chromium from coalescing every move into a single panstart with no panmove; that coalescing was reproduced in failed backward swipes. Avoid awaiting every move because host acknowledgements can slow the gesture. [CDPSession](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-cdpsession), [Input protocol](https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/tot/Input/). |
| Vite | 8.3.1 | 2026-09-29 | Admin builds with Rolldown; import warning types from `rolldown` rather than `rollup`. Keep the absolute `resolve.alias` for `~`. |
| Next.js | 16.4.0-canary.52 | 2026-10-04 | Its bundled SWC runs coverage plugin 0.0.33 in the website's complete Linux unit coverage suite; stable 16.3.6 fails to deserialize the plugin. For standalone tracing, production-alias development-only subprocess modules to filesystem-free stubs; `turbopackIgnore` comments do not prevent NFT from tracing local binaries. A production reproduction changed canonical diagnostic `0.9523809523809523` to `0.9523809523809524` through the built-in JSON parser. Preserve the canonical database as text (`turbopack.rules` type `text`, webpack `asset/source`) and parse with JavaScript; check every approved manifest against the actual standalone build in PR CI. [Turbopack rules](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/turbopack). |
| RustFS | 1.0.0 | 2026-09-27 | Official multi-platform image `rustfs/rustfs`; Apache-2.0, no license activation. Container UID 10001, named volume at `/data`; credentials use `RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY` / `RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY`. `/health/ready` waits for storage/IAM; `/health` is liveness only. Standard S3 bucket policies enable anonymous GetObject. Share digest-pinned Compose configuration between local development and CI; never reuse the MinIO volume directly. [Docker guide](https://docs.rustfs.com/en/installation/container/docker), [health probes](https://docs.rustfs.com/en/operations/status-check). |
| GitHub Container Registry | ghcr.io | 2026-10-04 | `GITHUB_TOKEN` with `packages: write` publishes; GitHub caps fork PR tokens to read-only, so forks cannot push. A package first pushed by a workflow is linked to its repository (also set `org.opencontainers.image.source`) and starts private; public visibility is a package setting. `docker manifest inspect` checks a tag without pulling. [Publishing with Actions](https://docs.github.com/en/packages/managing-github-packages-using-github-actions-workflows/publishing-and-installing-a-package-with-github-actions), [access control](https://docs.github.com/en/packages/learn-github-packages/configuring-a-packages-access-control-and-visibility). |
| GitHub release delivery | Actions `queue: max`; REST artifacts/jobs/deployments | 2026-10-06 | Queue release, bump and CD writers without cancelling pending work. Pin Actions artifact IDs and verify their archive digest; artifact names can be replaced by CI reruns. Use job history with `filter=all` and the published CI attempt to retain original quality evidence. Track successful target/platform delivery in Deployments. Release-by-tag lookup omits drafts: locate interrupted drafts through the authenticated paginated listing, then read and publish the release action's numeric ID only after asset verification. See [release recovery](../docs/github/workflows/ci/ci.md#draft-release-lookup-and-recovery). For fresh run monitoring, query by head SHA or filter the unfiltered run list locally: branch-filtered listings returned stale results during this investigation. Validate through `npm run test:version` in `devops`. [Concurrency](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#concurrency), [artifacts](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/artifacts), [jobs](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-jobs), [deployments](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/deployments/deployments). |
| Codex managed worktrees | desktop worktree tools | 2026-10-05 | Use a task-owned worktree unless the entire task is API-only. Check attached artifacts for a suitable worktree, create from the intended branch/ref, and wait for the asynchronous operation's final paths before using it. Attach registration failures through the app; archive through the app after delivery. Do not switch branches in a checkout being used by another chat. |
| hadolint-py | 2.15.1 | 2026-10-06 | Pre-commit hook wrapping the hadolint binary as a pip wheel (`language: python`) — chosen over the official `hadolint/hadolint` repo hooks because `hadolint` (system) requires a PATH install and `hadolint-docker` requires a daemon, neither available on pre-commit.ci. Fuzzy apk pins `pkg~=major` satisfy DL3018 and survive alpine repo bumps; apt glob pins `pkg=1.2.*` satisfy DL3008 and survive debian/ubuntu security updates. Inline `# hadolint ignore=RULE` binds to the instruction on the following line only. Fails on any finding by default (failure threshold includes info). |
| Codecov self-hosted | compose PoC @ 5a3c9ce | 2026-10-06 | Docker Compose proof of concept built on deprecated Codecov Enterprise On-Premises; README states it is not hardened for security and recommends Helm/Terraform for production. Stack includes web API, worker, frontend, Postgres, Redis, and MinIO, plus a required GitHub App integration and a self-generated license via `scripts/license.py` (no purchase; default 50-seat license). Last upstream push 2026-06-30. [Repo](https://github.com/codecov/self-hosted). |
| Website browser corpus | Next.js 16.4.0-canary.61; Lighthouse 13.5.0 | 2026-10-06 | Live version 0.2.463 shipped an 82,324,502-byte scripture chunk, producing mobile TBT over 10 seconds. Client imports are transitive: bookshelf date helpers, selected-book lookup and family-tree citation ranges all pulled the full corpus. Generate ignored navigation/calendar/citation metadata from the canonical source, and serve content-addressed book assets on demand. Passing whole books through static page props inflated the standalone output to 7.5 GiB and exceeded the server memory gate; avoid that duplication. Bound the browser book cache and lazy-load PDF download helpers. Preserve canonical text parsing and recitation precision; reject browser scripts over 5 MiB in production build tests. Local full builds can use Next's `CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL=3` to limit workers without changing repository or CI settings. [Server/client boundary](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/server-and-client-components). |
| Next.js native Windows route cache | 16.4.0-canary.61 | 2026-10-06 | Runtime cache keys retain decoded pathname quotes, which Windows cannot persist. Current upstream canary has the same implementation. Linux deployment is unaffected by this filesystem restriction; validate production caching on Linux/Docker/WSL. Preserve public commentary URLs and cache invalidation; avoid a private-framework adapter. [Supported fix follow-up](https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1999). |
| SWC native cache on Windows | @swc/core 1.16.13 | 2026-10-06 | The native addon validates replacement rights on its cache directory and every ancestor. A shared Temp directory or tool-granted default cache can fail `ERR_SWC_NATIVE_CACHE`. For isolated validation, use `SWC_NATIVE_BINDING_CACHE` pointing to a private user-owned cache beneath the user profile, with inheritance disabled and access scoped to that user and SYSTEM. Do not relax SWC validation or modify shared Temp/default-cache permissions. |
